run_inference_model: run the Inference model on an image and mask to produce a 3D reconstruction
load_image_for_sam3d: load an RGBA image from a file path for use with SAM 3D Objects
load_single_mask: load a single mask from an image directory by index for SAM 3D Objects
save_gaussian_splat_ply: save the Gaussian splat output from inference to a PLY file
summarize_demo_script: summarize the demo script that runs SAM 3D Objects inference and exports a Gaussian splat
